'''"Co-Pilot" Adaptive Anti-Collision System''' was a type of [[Collision detector/Legends|collision avoidance system]] manufactured by [[Fabritech/Legends|Fabritech]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic War]]. They were often used on [[Podracer/Legends|podracers]] to reduce the risk of crashes during races.<ref name="EV" />
